identificationModule.briefTitle: Adjuvant Targeted-therapy for Patients With Resected High-risk EGFR-mutant Stage IB-IIA Non-small Cell Lung Carcinoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II, Single-armed Study to Assess the Efficacy and Safety of Furmonertinib in Patients With Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor Mutation Positive Stage IB-IIA Non-small Cell Lung Carcinoma, Following Complete Tumour Resection.

descriptionModule.briefSummary:
This is a single-armed study designed to evaluate the safety and efficacy of adjuvant targeted-therapy in patients with epidermal growth factor receptor mutation positive stage IB-IIA non-small cell lung carcinoma and high-risk of recurrence following complete tumor resection.

The primary endpoint: 2-year DFS rate; The second endpoint: DFS

conditions: EGF-R Positive Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

armGroups.label: Experimental group
armGroups.description: Furmonertinib (80 mg orally, once daily) for 3 years.

interventions.name: Furmonertinib
interventions.description: Furmonertinib (80 mg orally, once daily) for 3 years.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Disease Free Survival (DFS) rate at 2 years
primaryOutcomes.description: Assess the Efficacy of Adjuvant Furmonertinib as Measured by 2-year Disease Free Survival (DFS) rate.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of receiving therapy until date of disease recurrence or death (by any cause in the absence of recurrence), up to approximately 4 years. Assessed at 2 years.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Assess the Efficacy of Adjuvant Furmonertinib as Measured by Disease Free Survival (DFS).
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of receiving therapy until date of disease recurrence or death (by any cause in the absence of recurrence), up to approximately 4 years.
